moonbase.note: A planned lunar habitat runs at 30% oxygen and 10.2 psi. No solid fuel in PSI was ever flight-tested above 22.2% oxygen, so any solid simulation above that is an extrapolation beyond the measured data.

gravity.note: NASA PSI contains no partial-gravity combustion data. Flame behaviour between 0 g and 1 g is unmeasured. The hypothesis that flame spread peaks near lunar gravity is untested; NASA's FM2 mission is designed to measure it.

surprises.title: Silicone burns on Earth but barely ignites in space
surprises.text: In SAFFIRE-II, silicone samples burned completely in normal gravity but produced essentially zero burn length in microgravity. This is the opposite of the usual assumption that microgravity makes materials safer or more dangerous in one consistent direction.

surprises.title: Flames that keep burning after they disappear
surprises.text: Large heptane droplets in FLEX continued to burn as invisible cool flames after the visible flame went out, producing carbon monoxide and formaldehyde with no light to detect. A fire can appear extinguished and still be consuming fuel and generating toxic gas.

surprises.title: One material burned completely while its neighbour never lit
surprises.text: In SAFFIRE-II sample 2-7, the PMMA portion was entirely consumed while the adjacent Nomex never ignited at all.

gaps: No combustion data exists at any gravity between 0 g and 1 g.
No solid fuel was flight-tested above 22.2% oxygen, while a lunar habitat is planned at 30%.
No solid-fuel tests were run at reduced pressure near 10.2 psi.
All SAME-R smoke data comes from heated, non-flaming samples, so no smoke measurements exist for genuine flaming fires.
No tests cover electronics, wiring insulation, foams or packaging materials, which make up much of a real spacecraft's fuel load.
BASS-II and BASS experimental tables record no outcome column; burn and extinction results exist only in the mission reports.

anomaly_descriptions.sensor_failure: Oxygen reading physically impossible; instrument fault confirmed in the mission report.
anomaly_descriptions.baseline_co_offset: Carbon monoxide recorded as negative; sensor zero point sits below zero.
anomaly_descriptions.raw_percent_typo: Oxygen written as 3400% or 2100%; read as 34% and 21%.
anomaly_descriptions.raw_thickness_typo: Thickness written as '037 mm'; read as 0.37 mm.
anomaly_descriptions.zero_pressure_outlier: Ambient pressure recorded as 0.0 mmHg, which is a vacuum.
anomaly_descriptions.material_filled_forward: Material cell was blank, meaning 'same as the row above'.
anomaly_descriptions.embedded_footnote: Row is a footnote explaining the table, not a test.
anomaly_descriptions.pre_test_flow_visualisation: Pre-test airflow check, not a burn.
anomaly_descriptions.duplicate_row: This row repeats an earlier row in the same file.
anomaly_descriptions.duplicate_row_block: Part of a block of rows duplicated in the source file.
anomaly_descriptions.maintenance_row: A hardware maintenance log entry, not a test.
anomaly_descriptions.date_year_typo: The year in this date is inconsistent with its neighbours.
anomaly_descriptions.negative_flow_reading: Air flow recorded as negative; instrument drift near zero.
anomaly_descriptions.telemetry_loss: Time column records a signal loss instead of a clock time.
anomaly_descriptions.time_format_variant: Time written with dots instead of colons.
anomaly_descriptions.non_numeric_frame_count: Frame count holds a word such as 'none' or 'video'.
anomaly_descriptions.sensor_over_range: Sensor reading exceeded its measurable range.
anomaly_descriptions.unreadable_cell: Cell contains a character that could not be decoded.
anomaly_descriptions.cool_flame_candidate: Conditions where invisible cool-flame burning may continue after visible extinction.
anomaly_descriptions.zero_ignition_day: A full test day on which no flame ignited.
